requested.title: Raw exception messages are rendered to users

parsedVerdicts.reasoning: The original implementation was vulnerable because `renderError` returned arbitrary objects' `message` values, and the shared Form and SessionsTab components rendered those values to users. The current `src/errors/index.ts` instead returns a message only when `isAppError` recognizes an actual `AppError` or its serialized representation with the `AppError` marker, an allowlisted error code, and a string `publicMessage`. Zod-style errors receive a fixed 422 message, while every other exception—including database, Better Auth, and generic `Error` instances—receives the fixed `An unexpected error occurred.` message. All production `AppError` construction sites use static public messages or the predefined defaults; none pass dependency exception text or attacker-controlled input as `publicMessage`. The client-facing Form and SessionsTab still call `renderError`, but unexpected server-function failures can therefore no longer carry their raw messages to those rendering sinks. `src/errors/index.test.ts` explicitly covers a simulated PostgreSQL constraint error and verifies that its raw message is replaced by the generic response. Git history identifies commit `a041f94337e958247fb48f6d2ab0ed41cb6dc446` (`Harden session and profile data handling`) immediately before the revalidation-results commit, consistent with the security-hardening changes now present.
